permit.processingNote: The term depends on the duty paid: 10 or 15 working days at the higher duties (Trend, 20 November 2019, on the State Migration Service's amended regulation); the standard term wasn't read on a primary page.

sources.title: Trend, Foreigners now able to get work permits in Azerbaijan even faster (20 November 2019); rests on the State Migration Service's Administrative Regulation on work permits and the Law on State Duty
sources.said: with reference to Azerbaijan’s State Migration Service. Now this permission can be obtained within 10 working days. … In accordance with the previous regulation, the state duty to obtain a work permit for paid labor activities of a foreigner and stateless person in Azerbaijan was set at 350 manat ($206.3) for a period of up to three months, 600 manat ($353.6) - up to six months, and 1,000 manat ($589.3) -up to one year. In accordance with the new regulation, depending on the size of the paid state duty, services will be provided within different periods. Thus, in order to obtain a work permit within 10 working days for a period of up to three months, it will be necessary to pay a state duty in the amount of 700 manat ($412.5), up to six months – 900 manat ($530.4), up to one year – 1,400 manat ($825.1). In order to get the specified permission within 15 working days, it is necessary to pay the state duty in the amount of 500 manat ($294.7), 700 manat ($412.5) and 1,200 manat ($707.3), respectively.
